baseline.description: Status quo — no CCS, no early retirements. Natural market-driven decline only.

ccs_top_emitters.description: CCS retrofit on top 6 CCS-eligible CCGT plants (95% capture). No retirements, no new builds.

ccs_plus_new_gas.description: CCS on top emitters + 1,200 MW new efficient CCGT in PJM (2028-2029).

retire_peakers_ccs_baseload.description: Retire all oil CTs and gas CTs by 2030, CCS retrofit on all CCGTs by 2035.

metadata.notes: Rebuilt from Rosetta CSV single source of truth. Nuclear ~190 TWh, Geothermal ~9 TWh, Wind/Solar/Hydro ~4-5 TWh. SBTi Power Sector v2: net zero by 2040.
